name: Social media - share link
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose Social media - share link.
Select Add block inside this section. Use the supported block types listed below, then drag them into the desired reading order.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.content: Native share links open the selected external service or email client. Publishing, login and service availability are controlled by that provider; no posting API or automatic confirmation is supplied.

settings.label: Eyebrow
settings.how: Enter the eyebrow. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.label: Hide eyebrow and description
settings.how: Turn on “Hide eyebrow and description” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.
